source.text: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἐπορεύθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς σάββασιν διὰ τῶν σπορίμων· οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπείνασαν καὶ ἤρξαντο τίλλειν στάχυας καὶ ἐσθίειν.

records.literal_gloss: At that the time went the Jesus on the Sabbaths through the grainfields; the and disciples of him were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

en.L: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath; and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
en.B: About that time Jesus was walking through the fields of grain on a Sabbath day. His disciples were hungry, so they started picking some heads of grain and eating them.
en.R: Around that time, Jesus was walking through some grain fields on the Sabbath, the day of rest. His followers were hungry. So they began to pick some grain and eat it.

es.L: En aquel tiempo Jesús pasó por los sembrados en sábado; y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos tuvieron hambre y comenzaron a arrancar espigas y a comer.
es.B: Por aquel tiempo, Jesús iba caminando un sábado por los sembrados. Sus discípulos tenían hambre, así que se pusieron a arrancar algunas espigas y a comérselas.
es.R: Por esos días, Jesús iba caminando por unos campos sembrados en sábado, el día de descanso. Sus discípulos tenían hambre. Por eso comenzaron a arrancar algunas espigas y a comerse el grano.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, Jésus passa un jour de sabbat à travers les champs de blé ; et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples eurent faim et se mirent à arracher des épis et à manger.
fr.B: Vers ce temps-là, un jour de sabbat, Jésus traversait des champs de blé. Ses disciples avaient faim ; ils se mirent donc à cueillir des épis et à en manger les grains.
fr.R: À cette époque-là, un jour de sabbat, le jour du repos, Jésus marchait à travers des champs de blé. Ses disciples avaient faim. Alors ils ont commencé à cueillir des épis et à en manger les grains.

sw.L: Wakati ule Yesu alipita katika mashamba ya nafaka siku ya Sabato; na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waliona njaa, wakaanza kuchuma masuke na kula.
sw.B: Wakati huo Yesu alikuwa akipita katika mashamba ya nafaka siku moja ya Sabato. Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa na njaa, kwa hiyo wakaanza kuchuma masuke na kuyala.
sw.R: Wakati huo Yesu alikuwa akitembea katika mashamba ya nafaka siku ya Sabato, siku ya mapumziko. Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa na njaa. Kwa hiyo wakaanza kuchuma masuke, wakala nafaka.

vi.L: Vào lúc ấy, Đức Giê-xu đi qua các đồng lúa trong ngày Sa-bát; và các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đói, và bắt đầu bứt các bông lúa mà ăn.
vi.B: Khoảng thời gian ấy, vào một ngày Sa-bát, Đức Giê-xu đi ngang qua các đồng lúa. Các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đói, nên bắt đầu bứt bông lúa ăn.
vi.R: Vào khoảng thời gian đó, có một ngày Sa-bát, là ngày nghỉ, Đức Giê-xu đi ngang qua mấy đồng lúa. Các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đói bụng, nên họ bứt mấy bông lúa để ăn.

ko.L: 그때에 예수께서 안식일에 곡식밭 사이로 지나가셨다. 그런데 그분의 제자들이 배가 고파서 이삭을 따서 먹기 시작했다.
ko.B: 그 무렵 어느 안식일에 예수께서 곡식밭 사이로 지나가고 계셨다. 제자들은 배가 고파서 이삭을 따서 먹기 시작했다.
ko.R: 그 무렵 어느 안식일에 예수께서 곡식밭 사이로 걸어가고 계셨다. 안식일은 일을 하지 않고 쉬는 날이었다. 제자들은 배가 고팠다. 그래서 곡식 이삭을 따서 먹기 시작했다.

decisions.choice: plucking grain: allowed in a neighbor's field, but counted as work on the Sabbath
decisions.reason: The law let a hungry traveler pick grain by hand in someone else's field (Deuteronomy 23:25). The question is the day: harvesting was forbidden on the Sabbath (Exodus 34:21), and plucking could be counted as harvesting.

decisions.choice: on the Sabbath: one Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The Greek often uses the plural for a single Sabbath day.

decisions.choice: at that time: the scene follows Jesus's promise of rest (11:28-30)
decisions.reason: Matthew joins the Sabbath stories to the call to find rest in Jesus. The link is one of placement, not of time.

decisions.choice: the day of rest
decisions.reason: Readable says what the Sabbath is.

decisions.choice: sábado; R adds "el día de descanso"
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for the whole New Testament. Spanish "sábado" is also the everyday name for Saturday, so Readable says once what the day was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: discípulos at every level
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "followers", Spanish keeps "discípulos", a common word that every reader knows, as in John 1:35-37. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Matthew's historic present kept at Literal (12:13 "il dit"); speech in the passé composé at every level, David's story (12:3-4) included
decisions.reason: As in John, Mark and Luke: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the tense of speech and of stories for young readers. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: un jour de sabbat, le sabbat (lowercase) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form: "sabbat" is a common noun in French and takes no capital. The Greek plural names one Sabbath day (m2), so French says "un jour de sabbat". Readable adds "le jour du repos", as the English does.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi at every level
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "followers", Swahili keeps "wanafunzi", the everyday word for a teacher's disciples, as in John. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: "ngày Sa-bát"; "đồng lúa", "bông lúa"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 2:23. Readable adds "là ngày nghỉ", as the English Readable adds "the day of rest".

decisions.choice: "안식일" for the plural "Sabbaths"; "곡식밭"; worded as the Korean Mark 2:23
decisions.reason: The plural means one Sabbath day (meaning decision), so Korean writes the singular at every level. The scene is the same as Mark 2:23-28, so the Korean follows the Korean Mark's words where the Greek is alike. Readable says what the Sabbath was, as the English Readable does; no deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 12.

decisions.choice: "안식일은 일을 하지 않고 쉬는 날이었다" (R)
decisions.reason: Plucking grain was allowed in a neighbor's field but counted as work on the Sabbath (meaning decision); Readable says what the day was so that the charge in 12:2 makes sense.

source.text: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἰδόντες εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἰδοὺ οἱ μαθηταί σου ποιοῦσιν ὃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ποιεῖν ἐν σαββάτῳ.

records.literal_gloss: The but Pharisees having seen said to him, Look, the disciples of you are doing what not is lawful to do on Sabbath.

en.L: But the Pharisees, seeing [this], said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Look, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} disciples are doing what is not lawful to do on [the] Sabbath."
en.B: The Pharisees saw it and said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "See there! Your disciples are doing something that the law forbids on the Sabbath."
en.R: Some Pharisees saw this. They said to Jesus, "Look! Your followers are doing something that is against the law on the Sabbath."

es.L: Pero los fariseos, viendo [esto], {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «Mira, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} discípulos hacen lo que no es lícito hacer en sábado».
es.B: Los fariseos lo vieron y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «¡Fíjate! Tus discípulos están haciendo algo que la ley prohíbe en sábado».
es.R: Unos fariseos vieron esto y le dijeron a Jesús: «¡Mira! Tus discípulos están haciendo algo que va contra la ley en sábado».

fr.L: Mais les Pharisiens, voyant [cela], {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Regarde, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} disciples font ce qu’il n’est pas permis de faire un jour de sabbat. »
fr.B: Les Pharisiens le virent et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Vois donc ! Tes disciples font ce que la Loi défend le jour du sabbat. »
fr.R: Des Pharisiens ont vu cela. Ils ont dit à Jésus : « Regarde ! Tes disciples font une chose que la Loi interdit le jour du sabbat. »

sw.L: Lakini Mafarisayo, walipoona [hivyo], wakamwambia, "Tazama, wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanafanya jambo lisilo halali kufanywa katika Sabato."
sw.B: Mafarisayo walipoona hivyo, wakamwambia, "Angalia! Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanafanya jambo ambalo sheria inakataza siku ya Sabato."
sw.R: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo waliona jambo hilo. Wakamwambia Yesu, "Tazama! Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanafanya jambo lililo kinyume cha sheria siku ya Sabato."

vi.L: Nhưng những người Pha-ri-si thấy [vậy] thì nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Kìa, môn đồ của ông đang làm điều không được phép làm trong ngày Sa-bát."
vi.B: Thấy vậy, những người Pha-ri-si nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ông xem kìa! Môn đồ của ông đang làm điều luật pháp cấm làm trong ngày Sa-bát."
vi.R: Có mấy người Pha-ri-si thấy vậy. Họ nói với Đức Giê-xu: "Ông xem kìa! Môn đồ của ông đang làm điều trái với luật pháp trong ngày Sa-bát."

ko.L: 그러나 바리새파 사람들이 [이것을] 보고 그분께 말했다. "보십시오, 선생님의 제자들이 안식일에 해서는 안 되는 일을 하고 있습니다."
ko.B: 바리새파 사람들이 이것을 보고 예수께 말했다. "보십시오! 선생님의 제자들이 안식일에 율법이 금하는 일을 하고 있습니다."
ko.R: 바리새파 사람들이 이것을 보고 예수께 말했다. "보십시오! 선생님의 제자들이 안식일 법을 어기고 있습니다."

decisions.choice: not lawful: forbidden by the law as the Pharisees understood it
decisions.reason: The Pharisees counted plucking grain as the work of harvesting, which the law of Moses forbade on the Sabbath.

decisions.choice: look (L, R); see there (B)
decisions.reason: In speech the word points to something happening in front of them, so it is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus.

decisions.choice: spans only on free pronouns and possessives
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: As in John and Romans: Swahili marks "him" inside the verb ("wakamwambia"), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives ("wako"). Swahili has fewer spans than English throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: "ông" for "your" in the Pharisees' words, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in Mark 2:24: the Pharisees speak to Jesus as an equal they are challenging, so they say "ông", which is not a pronoun of reverence and takes no setting span.

decisions.choice: the Pharisees speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "선생님의" for "your"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 2:24: their challenge is in what they say, not in open contempt, so the style guide's default for people speaking to Jesus holds, and Korean says "선생님" for "you" to a teacher.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε τί ἐποίησεν Δαυὶδ ὅτε ἐπείνασεν καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: He but said to them, Not have you read what did David when he was hungry and those with him?

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, and those with him?
en.B: Jesus answered them, "Do you not remember reading what David did when he and the men with him were hungry?
en.R: Jesus answered, "Have you not read about what David did when he and his men were hungry?

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¿No {{plural_you:han|habéis}} leído lo que hizo David cuando tuvo hambre, y los que [estaban] con él?
es.B: Jesús les respondió: «¿No {{plural_you:recuerdan|recordáis}} haber leído lo que hizo David cuando él y los hombres que lo acompañaban tuvieron hambre?
es.R: Jesús les contestó: «¿No {{plural_you:han|habéis}} leído lo que hizo David cuando él y sus hombres tuvieron hambre?

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « N’avez-vous pas lu ce qu’a fait David quand il a eu faim, ainsi que ceux [qui étaient] avec lui ?
fr.B: Jésus leur répondit : « Ne vous souvenez-vous pas d’avoir lu ce qu’a fait David quand lui et ses compagnons ont eu faim ?
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Vous n’avez pas lu ce qu’a fait David, un jour où lui et ses hommes avaient faim ?

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akawaambia, "Je, hamjasoma alichofanya Daudi alipoona njaa, na wale [waliokuwa] pamoja naye?
sw.B: Yesu akawajibu, "Je, hamkumbuki kusoma alichofanya Daudi wakati yeye na watu aliokuwa nao walipoona njaa?
sw.R: Yesu akawajibu, "Je, hamjasoma habari ya alichofanya Daudi wakati yeye na watu wake walipokuwa na njaa?

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các người chưa đọc điều Đa-vít đã làm khi ông và những người đi với ông bị đói sao?
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Các người chưa đọc việc Đa-vít đã làm khi ông và những người theo ông bị đói sao?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Các người chưa đọc trong Kinh Thánh về việc Đa-vít đã làm khi ông và những người theo ông bị đói sao?

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 다윗과 그와 함께 있던 사람들이 굶주렸을 때에 다윗이 무엇을 했는지 읽지 못했느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 대답하셨다. "다윗과 그 일행이 배고팠을 때 다윗이 어떻게 했는지 너희는 읽어 보지 못했느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "다윗과 그의 부하들이 배가 고팠을 때 다윗이 한 일을 너희는 성경에서 읽어 보지 않았느냐?

decisions.choice: what David did: 1 Samuel 21:1-6
decisions.reason: David, fleeing from Saul, asked the priest at Nob for bread and was given the holy bread.

decisions.choice: have you not read: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The Pharisees knew the Scriptures well. Jesus asks whether they have understood what they read.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Jesus answers the Pharisees as a group, so every plural "you" and its verb in his reply (12:3-8 and 12:11-12) is the reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain).

decisions.choice: "các người" for the Pharisees, through 12:12
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to opponents, as in Mark 2:25.

decisions.choice: "읽지 못했느냐" (L), "읽어 보지 못했느냐" (B), "읽어 보지 않았느냐" (R)
decisions.reason: The question expects "yes" (meaning decision); a negative question keeps that force in Korean, as in the Korean Mark 2:25.

source.text: πῶς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως ἔφαγον, ὃ οὐκ ἐξὸν ἦν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν οὐδὲ τοῖς μετ’ αὐτοῦ, εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν μόνοις;

records.literal_gloss: how he entered into the house of the God and the loaves of the presentation they ate, which not lawful was for him to eat nor for those with him, except for the priests only?

en.L: How he entered the house of God, and they ate the loaves of the presentation, which it was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those with him, but only for the priests?
en.B: He went into the house of God, and they ate the sacred bread set out before God. Neither David nor his men were allowed to eat it; only the priests were.
en.R: David went into the house of God, and they ate the special bread that had been placed there before God. The law did not allow David or his men to eat that bread. Only the priests were allowed to eat it.

es.L: ¿Cómo entró en la casa de Dios, y comieron los panes de la presentación, que no le era lícito comer a él, ni a los que [estaban] con él, sino solo a los sacerdotes?
es.B: Entró en la casa de Dios, y comieron los panes consagrados que se ponían delante de Dios. Ni David ni sus hombres tenían permiso para comerlos; solo los sacerdotes.
es.R: David entró en la casa de Dios, y comieron el pan especial que habían puesto allí delante de Dios. La ley no les permitía ni a David ni a sus hombres comer ese pan. Solo los sacerdotes podían comerlo.

fr.L: Comment il est entré dans la maison de Dieu, et [comment] ils ont mangé les pains de la présentation, qu’il ne lui était pas permis de manger, ni à ceux [qui étaient] avec lui, mais aux prêtres seuls ?
fr.B: Il est entré dans la maison de Dieu, et ils ont mangé les pains sacrés présentés devant Dieu. Ni David ni ses hommes n’avaient le droit d’en manger ; seuls les prêtres l’avaient.
fr.R: David est entré dans la maison de Dieu, et ils ont mangé le pain spécial qu’on avait placé là, devant Dieu. La Loi ne permettait ni à David ni à ses hommes de manger ce pain. Seuls les prêtres avaient le droit d’en manger.

sw.L: Jinsi alivyoingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, nao wakala mikate ya kuwekwa mbele [za Mungu], ambayo haikuwa halali kwake kuila, wala kwa wale [waliokuwa] pamoja naye, ila kwa makuhani peke yao?
sw.B: Aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, nao wakala mikate mitakatifu iliyowekwa mbele za Mungu. Daudi na watu wake hawakuruhusiwa kuila; ni makuhani tu walioruhusiwa.
sw.R: Daudi aliingia katika nyumba ya Mungu, nao wakala mikate maalum iliyokuwa imewekwa pale mbele za Mungu. Sheria haikumruhusu Daudi wala watu wake kula mikate hiyo. Makuhani peke yao ndio walioruhusiwa kuila.

vi.L: thế nào ông đã vào nhà Đức Chúa Trời, và họ đã ăn các ổ bánh bày ra [trước Đức Chúa Trời], là bánh mà ông không được phép ăn, những người đi với ông cũng không được, nhưng chỉ các thầy tế lễ mà thôi?
vi.B: Ông đã vào nhà Đức Chúa Trời, và họ đã ăn bánh bày ra trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. Luật pháp không cho phép ông và những người theo ông ăn bánh ấy, chỉ các thầy tế lễ mới được ăn.
vi.R: Đa-vít đã vào nhà của Đức Chúa Trời, và họ đã ăn thứ bánh đặc biệt đã được đặt ở đó trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. Luật pháp không cho Đa-vít và những người theo ông ăn bánh ấy. Chỉ các thầy tế lễ mới được ăn.

ko.L: 그가 어떻게 하나님의 집에 들어가서, 그와 그와 함께 있던 사람들이 먹어서는 안 되고 오직 제사장들만 [먹을 수 있는] 차려 놓은 빵을 그들이 먹었는지 [읽지 못했느냐]?
ko.B: 다윗은 하나님의 집에 들어갔고, 그들은 하나님 앞에 차려 놓은 빵을 먹었다. 그 빵은 다윗도, 그와 함께 있던 사람들도 먹을 수 없었고, 오직 제사장들만 먹을 수 있었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 하나님의 집에 들어갔다. 그리고 그들은 하나님께 바친 특별한 빵을 먹었다. 율법은 다윗이나 그의 부하들이 그 빵을 먹는 것을 허락하지 않았다. 오직 제사장들만 그 빵을 먹을 수 있었다.

decisions.choice: the loaves of the presentation: the twelve loaves set out before God
decisions.reason: Twelve loaves were placed on a table in the holy place each Sabbath and were afterward eaten only by the priests (Leviticus 24:5-9; Exodus 25:30).

decisions.choice: the house of God: the tabernacle, then at Nob
decisions.reason: The temple had not yet been built. The tent of meeting stood at Nob (1 Samuel 21:1).

decisions.choice: they ate, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: he ate, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "he ate". Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: statements instead of a question
decisions.reason: The verse continues the question of 12:3. Balanced and Readable tell the story as statements so it is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: los panes de la presentación (L); los panes consagrados (B); el pan especial (R)
decisions.reason: "Proposición" once meant setting something out, but readers now take it as a proposal. "Presentación" keeps the Greek picture of bread set out before God (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say what the bread was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mikate ya kuwekwa mbele [za Mungu] (L); mikate mitakatifu (B); mikate maalum (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek names the bread by its being set out before God (meaning decision m1). Literal says that in plain words; Balanced calls it holy bread and Readable special bread, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các ổ bánh bày ra" (L); "bánh bày ra trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời" (B); "thứ bánh đặc biệt" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 2:26: the twelve loaves set out before God (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "차려 놓은 빵" (L); "하나님 앞에 차려 놓은 빵" (B); "하나님께 바친 특별한 빵" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 2:26, where the same loaves appear (meaning decision); "진설병" is the older church word, unknown to most readers. Literal repeats "[읽지 못했느냐]" because the Greek "how he entered" continues the question of 12:3.

source.text: ἢ οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι τοῖς σάββασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τὸ σάββατον βεβηλοῦσιν καὶ ἀναίτιοί εἰσιν;

records.literal_gloss: Or not have you read in the law that on the Sabbaths the priests in the temple the Sabbath profane and guiltless are?

en.L: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?
en.B: Or have you not read in the law that every Sabbath the priests working in the temple break the Sabbath, and still they bear no guilt?
en.R: And have you not read in the Law of Moses that the priests work in the temple on the Sabbath? They break the Sabbath rules, but God does not count them guilty.

es.L: ¿O no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} leído en la ley que en sábado los sacerdotes en el templo profanan el sábado y son inocentes?
es.B: ¿O no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} leído en la ley que cada sábado los sacerdotes que trabajan en el templo quebrantan el sábado, y aun así no son culpables?
es.R: ¿Y no {{plural_you:han|habéis}} leído en la Ley de Moisés que los sacerdotes trabajan en el templo el sábado? Quebrantan las reglas del sábado, pero Dios no los considera culpables.

fr.L: Ou bien n’avez-vous pas lu dans la Loi que, le jour du sabbat, les prêtres dans le temple profanent le sabbat et sont innocents ?
fr.B: Ou n’avez-vous pas lu dans la Loi que, chaque sabbat, les prêtres qui servent dans le temple violent le sabbat sans être coupables pour autant ?
fr.R: Et vous n’avez pas lu dans la Loi de Moïse que les prêtres travaillent dans le temple le jour du sabbat ? Ils ne respectent pas les règles du sabbat, mais Dieu ne les considère pas comme coupables.

sw.L: Au hamjasoma katika sheria kwamba katika Sabato makuhani ndani ya hekalu huinajisi Sabato, nao hawana hatia?
sw.B: Au hamjasoma katika sheria kwamba kila Sabato makuhani wanaofanya kazi hekaluni huivunja Sabato, na bado hawana hatia?
sw.R: Tena, hamjasoma katika sheria ya Musa kwamba makuhani hufanya kazi hekaluni siku ya Sabato? Wanavunja kanuni za Sabato, lakini Mungu hawahesabu kuwa wenye hatia.

vi.L: Hay các người chưa đọc trong luật pháp rằng trong ngày Sa-bát, các thầy tế lễ ở trong đền thờ làm ô uế ngày Sa-bát mà không có tội sao?
vi.B: Hay các người chưa đọc trong luật pháp rằng mỗi ngày Sa-bát, các thầy tế lễ làm việc trong đền thờ đều phạm luật ngày Sa-bát mà vẫn không mắc tội sao?
vi.R: Các người cũng chưa đọc trong luật pháp Môi-se rằng các thầy tế lễ làm việc trong đền thờ vào ngày Sa-bát sao? Họ làm điều luật ngày Sa-bát cấm, nhưng Đức Chúa Trời không coi họ là có tội.

ko.L: 또는 안식일에 제사장들이 성전에서 안식일을 속되게 하여도 죄가 없다는 것을 너희는 율법에서 읽지 못했느냐?
ko.B: 또 안식일마다 제사장들이 성전에서 일하면서 안식일을 어기지만 죄가 없다는 것을 너희는 율법에서 읽지 못했느냐?
ko.R: 또 너희는 모세의 율법에서 이런 말씀을 읽지 않았느냐? 제사장들은 안식일에도 성전에서 일한다. 그들은 안식일 규정을 어기지만, 하나님께서는 그들에게 죄가 있다고 하지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: the priests' Sabbath work: the offerings and the holy bread
decisions.reason: The law required extra offerings on the Sabbath (Numbers 28:9-10), and the holy bread was set out every Sabbath (Leviticus 24:8). The priests worked so that this could be done.

decisions.choice: profane: treat as ordinary, by doing work the day otherwise forbids
decisions.reason: The priests do not despise the Sabbath. They do on it what would be work on any other day.

decisions.choice: on the Sabbath: one Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The Greek often uses the plural for a single Sabbath day.

decisions.choice: God does not count them guilty
decisions.reason: Readable says who holds them innocent: the law God gave.

decisions.choice: inocentes (L), as in 12:7
decisions.reason: The same Greek word comes back in 12:7 for the disciples (meaning decision m2 there), so Literal uses "inocentes" both times and the link stays visible.

decisions.choice: le temple at every level, here and in 12:6
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "la cour du temple" at Balanced and Readable for scenes in the outer courts. Here the priests' service and the comparison in 12:6 concern the sanctuary as a whole, so "le temple" is the right word at every level, as in the English.

decisions.choice: huinajisi (L); huivunja (B)
decisions.reason: "Kunajisi" is to make common what is holy, the sense of the Greek word (meaning decision m2); Balanced says "break" the Sabbath, as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "làm ô uế" (L); "phạm luật" (B)
decisions.reason: To profane the day is to treat it as ordinary by doing work it forbids (meaning decision); Literal keeps the strong word, Balanced says what the priests did.

decisions.choice: "속되게 하다" (L); "어기다" (B, R); "성전" at every level here and in 12:6
decisions.reason: To profane is to treat the holy day as ordinary by doing the work it otherwise forbids (meaning decision); "속되게 하다" says that at Literal, and "어기다" says it plainly. The priests' work (meaning decision) and the comparison in 12:6 concern the temple as a whole, so "성전" is kept at every level rather than the "성전 뜰" the style guide uses where Jesus teaches in its courts.

source.text: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦ ἱεροῦ μεῖζόν ἐστιν ὧδε.

records.literal_gloss: I say but to you that the temple greater is here.

en.L: But I tell you that [something] greater than the temple is here.
en.B: I tell you, here is something greater than the temple.
en.R: But I tell you, something more important than the temple is here with you now.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que [algo] mayor que el templo está aquí.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que aquí hay algo mayor que el templo.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que algo más importante que el templo está aquí con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ahora.

fr.L: Or je vous dis que [quelque chose de] plus grand que le temple est ici.
fr.B: Je vous le dis : il y a ici plus grand que le temple.
fr.R: Mais je vous le dis : il y a ici, avec vous, quelque chose de plus important que le temple.

sw.L: Lakini nawaambia kwamba [kitu] kikubwa kuliko hekalu kipo hapa.
sw.B: Nawaambia, hapa kuna kitu kikubwa kuliko hekalu.
sw.R: Lakini nawaambia, kitu kilicho muhimu zaidi kuliko hekalu kipo hapa pamoja nanyi sasa.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người rằng ở đây có [điều] lớn hơn đền thờ.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, ở đây có điều còn lớn hơn đền thờ.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, ngay bây giờ ở đây có điều còn quan trọng hơn đền thờ.

ko.L: 그러나 내가 너희에게 말한다. 성전보다 더 큰 [것이] 여기에 있다.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 성전보다 더 큰 것이 여기에 있다.
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 성전보다 더 중요한 것이 지금 여기 너희와 함께 있다.

decisions.choice: something greater: the word is neuter
decisions.reason: The neuter points to Jesus and what God is doing through him, which is greater than the temple and its service. If priests serving the temple are guiltless, so are those who serve him.

decisions.choice: here with you now
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that "here" means in their presence.

decisions.choice: kitu kikubwa, in the ki-class
decisions.reason: The Greek word is neuter, "something" greater (meaning decision m1). Swahili must choose a noun class: the ki-class "kitu kikubwa" keeps it a thing, as the Greek does, where "mtu mkubwa" would decide that a person is meant.

decisions.choice: "điều" (thing) for "something greater"
decisions.reason: The word is neuter (meaning decision, with its footnote); "điều" keeps it open, as the Greek does, rather than naming a person.

decisions.choice: "더 큰 것"
decisions.reason: The word is neuter, "something greater" (meaning decision, footnoted); Korean "것" keeps that, without deciding whether Jesus or the kingdom is meant.

source.text: εἰ δὲ ἐγνώκειτε τί ἐστιν· Ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν, οὐκ ἂν κατεδικάσατε τοὺς ἀναιτίους.

records.literal_gloss: If but you had known what is, Mercy I desire and not sacrifice, not would you have condemned the guiltless.

en.L: But if you had understood what this is, 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' you would not have condemned those who are guiltless.
en.B: If you had understood what the words mean, 'I want mercy, not sacrifice,' you would not have condemned people who have done nothing wrong.
en.R: The Scriptures say, 'I want you to show mercy to people, more than I want you to offer sacrifices.' If you had understood what that means, you would not have judged these innocent men to be guilty.

es.L: Pero si {{plural_you:hubieran|hubierais}} sabido qué es: “Misericordia deseo, y no sacrificio”, no {{plural_you:habrían|habríais}} condenado a los inocentes.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:hubieran|hubierais}} entendido lo que significan las palabras “Quiero misericordia, no sacrificio”, no {{plural_you:habrían|habríais}} condenado a quienes no han hecho nada malo.
es.R: Las Escrituras dicen: “Prefiero que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} compasivos con la gente, más que me {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} sacrificios”. Si {{plural_you:hubieran|hubierais}} entendido lo que eso significa, no {{plural_you:habrían|habríais}} declarado culpables a estos hombres inocentes.

fr.L: Mais si vous aviez compris ce que signifie : “Je veux la miséricorde, et non le sacrifice”, vous n’auriez pas condamné ceux qui sont innocents.
fr.B: Si vous aviez compris le sens de ces paroles : “Ce que je veux, c’est la miséricorde, non le sacrifice”, vous n’auriez pas condamné des gens qui n’ont rien fait de mal.
fr.R: Les Écritures disent : “Je veux que vous ayez pitié des autres, plus que je ne veux que vous m’offriez des sacrifices.” Si vous aviez compris ce que cela veut dire, vous n’auriez pas déclaré coupables ces hommes innocents.

sw.L: Lakini kama mngekuwa mmejua maana [ya maneno haya], 'Nataka huruma, wala si dhabihu,' msingewahukumu wasio na hatia.
sw.B: Kama mngekuwa mmeelewa maana ya maneno haya, 'Nataka huruma, si dhabihu,' msingewahukumu watu ambao hawajafanya kosa lolote.
sw.R: Maandiko yanasema, 'Ninataka mwonyeshe watu huruma kuliko ninavyotaka mnitolee dhabihu.' Kama mngeelewa maana ya maneno hayo, msingewahukumu watu hawa wasio na hatia.

vi.L: Nếu các người đã hiểu [lời] này nghĩa là gì: 'Ta muốn lòng thương xót, chứ không phải của lễ,' thì các người đã không kết án những người vô tội.
vi.B: Nếu các người đã hiểu lời này có nghĩa gì: 'Ta muốn lòng thương xót, chứ không phải của lễ,' thì các người đã không lên án những người không có lỗi.
vi.R: Kinh Thánh chép: 'Ta muốn các người thương xót người khác hơn là dâng của lễ cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.' Nếu các người hiểu lời ấy có nghĩa gì, thì các người đã không kết tội những người vô tội này.

ko.L: 너희가 '나는 자비를 원하고, 제사를 [원하지] 않는다'가 무슨 뜻인지 알았더라면, 죄 없는 사람들을 정죄하지 않았을 것이다.
ko.B: '나는 자비를 원하지, 제사를 원하지 않는다'는 말씀이 무슨 뜻인지 너희가 알았더라면, 아무 잘못도 없는 사람들을 정죄하지 않았을 것이다.
ko.R: 성경에 '나는 너희가 제물을 바치는 것보다, 사람들에게 자비를 베푸는 것을 더 원한다' 하는 말씀이 있다. 너희가 이 말씀이 무슨 뜻인지 알았더라면, 죄 없는 내 제자들에게 죄가 있다고 하지 않았을 것이다.

decisions.choice: I desire mercy, not sacrifice: Hosea 6:6, quoted already in 9:13
decisions.reason: God wants faithful love more than offerings. The "not" ranks the two. The wording is kept the same as in 9:13 at each level.

decisions.choice: the guiltless: the disciples
decisions.reason: The same word described the priests in 12:5. The disciples are as innocent as they are.

decisions.choice: the quotation first, then the condition
decisions.reason: Readable gives the Scripture before saying what they failed to understand.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} in the quotation
decisions.reason: Readable spells out whom God addresses in Hosea, his people, so the plural "you" inside the quotation also takes the ustedes / vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: huruma; dhabihu
decisions.reason: Hosea speaks of mercy shown to other people (meaning decision m1), and "huruma" is the everyday word for that, while "rehema" is used mostly of God's mercy. "Dhabihu" is a sacrifice offered on an altar, narrower than "sadaka", which can be any gift.

decisions.choice: "Ta muốn lòng thương xót, chứ không phải của lễ"
decisions.reason: The words of Hosea 6:6 worded as in 9:13, where Matthew quotes them first (meaning decision). God speaks, so "Ta" at the start of the quotation is written plainly.

decisions.choice: Hosea 6:6 worded as in the Korean Matthew 9:13 at each level
decisions.reason: Matthew quotes Hosea 6:6 here for the second time (meaning decision), so the Korean repeats its wording of 9:13.

decisions.choice: "죄 없는 내 제자들" (R)
decisions.reason: The guiltless are the disciples (meaning decision); Readable says so, as the English Readable says "these innocent men".

source.text: κύριος γάρ ἐστιν τοῦ σαββάτου ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

records.literal_gloss: Lord for is of the Sabbath the Son of the Man.

en.L: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
en.B: For the Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath."
en.R: The Son of Man is the Lord who rules over the Sabbath day."

es.L: Porque Señor del sábado es el Hijo del Hombre».
es.B: Porque el Hijo del Hombre es Señor del sábado».
es.R: El Hijo del Hombre es el Señor que tiene autoridad sobre el sábado».

fr.L: Car le Fils de l’homme est Seigneur du sabbat. »
fr.B: Oui, le Fils de l’homme est Seigneur du sabbat. »
fr.R: Le Fils de l’homme est le Seigneur qui a autorité sur le sabbat. »

sw.L: Kwa maana Bwana wa Sabato ni Mwana wa Adamu."
sw.B: Kwa kuwa Mwana wa Adamu ni Bwana wa Sabato."
sw.R: Mwana wa Adamu ndiye Bwana anayetawala siku ya Sabato."

vi.L: Vì Con Người là Chúa của ngày Sa-bát."
vi.B: Vì Con Người là Chúa của ngày Sa-bát."
vi.R: Con Người là Chúa, là Đấng có quyền trên ngày Sa-bát."

ko.L: 인자는 안식일의 주이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 인자는 안식일을 다스리는 주이다."
ko.R: 인자는 안식일까지도 다스리는 주인이다."

decisions.choice: Lord of the Sabbath: Jesus has authority over the day God gave
decisions.reason: God made the Sabbath holy (Exodus 20:8-11). The Son of Man has the right to say what the day allows.

decisions.choice: Lord: placed first in the sentence for emphasis
decisions.reason: The Greek puts "Lord" at the head of the sentence.

decisions.choice: Señor del sábado first (L)
decisions.reason: Spanish can put "Señor" first, as the Greek does for emphasis (meaning decision m2), and still read clearly, so Literal keeps that order where the English cannot.

decisions.choice: Bwana wa Sabato first (L)
decisions.reason: Swahili can put "Bwana wa Sabato" first, as the Greek does for emphasis (meaning decision m2), so Literal keeps that order where the English cannot.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu
decisions.reason: The term chosen for the whole New Testament, as in John: the settled Swahili title, never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: "Chúa của ngày Sa-bát"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 2:28: Jesus has authority over the day God gave (meaning decision), and "Chúa" keeps the title.
As in the Korean Mark 2:28: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son of Man, and a Korean speaker does not use the honorific "-님" of himself, so "주" keeps the title without it.

source.text: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν αὐτῶν·

records.literal_gloss: And having moved on from there he came into the synagogue of them;

en.L: And moving on from there, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went into their synagogue.
en.B: Jesus left that place and went into their synagogue.
en.R: Then Jesus went on from there and entered their synagogue, the place where people met to worship.

es.L: Y yéndose de allí, entró en la sinagoga de ellos.
es.B: Jesús salió de allí y entró en la sinagoga de ellos.
es.R: Luego Jesús siguió su camino y entró en la sinagoga de ellos, el lugar donde la gente se reunía para adorar a Dios.

fr.L: Et, étant parti de là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} alla dans leur synagogue.
fr.B: Jésus quitta cet endroit et entra dans leur synagogue.
fr.R: Puis Jésus est parti de là et il est entré dans leur synagogue, l’endroit où les gens se réunissaient pour adorer Dieu.

sw.L: Na alipoondoka hapo, akaingia katika sinagogi lao.
sw.B: Yesu aliondoka mahali pale, akaingia katika sinagogi lao.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akaendelea na safari, akaingia katika sinagogi lao, mahali ambapo watu walikutana kumwabudu Mungu.

vi.L: Và rời khỏi đó, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào nhà hội của họ.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu rời nơi ấy và vào nhà hội của họ.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu rời nơi đó và đi vào nhà hội của họ, là nơi người ta nhóm lại để thờ phượng.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 거기에서 떠나 그들의 회당에 들어가셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그곳을 떠나 그들의 회당에 들어가셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 그곳을 떠나 그 마을의 회당에 들어가셨다. 회당은 사람들이 모여서 하나님께 예배하는 곳이었다.

decisions.choice: their synagogue: the synagogue of the people of that place
alternatives: a synagogue belonging to the Pharisees
decisions.reason: Matthew often says "their synagogues" (4:23; 9:35). The Pharisees of 12:2 are present there (12:14).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: A new scene begins, so Balanced and Readable name Jesus.

decisions.choice: la sinagoga de ellos
decisions.reason: Spanish "su sinagoga" could be read as Jesus's own synagogue; "de ellos" points to the people of the place (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "그 마을의 회당" and what a synagogue is (R)
decisions.reason: "Their synagogue" is the synagogue of the people of that place (meaning decision); Readable says so and explains the word, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος χεῖρα ἔχων ξηράν.

records.literal_gloss: And behold, a man a hand having withered.

en.L: And look, [there was] a man having a withered hand.
en.B: A man was there whose hand was shriveled.
en.R: There was a man there with a hand that was shriveled and useless.

es.L: Y he aquí, [había] un hombre que tenía una mano seca.
es.B: Allí había un hombre que tenía una mano atrofiada.
es.R: Allí había un hombre que tenía una mano seca, que no podía usar.

fr.L: Et voici, [il y avait là] un homme qui avait une main desséchée.
fr.B: Il s’y trouvait un homme dont la main était desséchée.
fr.R: Il y avait là un homme qui avait une main toute sèche ; il ne pouvait plus s’en servir.

sw.L: Na tazama, [palikuwa na] mtu mwenye mkono uliokauka.
sw.B: Palikuwa na mtu mmoja ambaye mkono wake ulikuwa umesinyaa.
sw.R: Pale palikuwa na mtu ambaye mkono wake ulikuwa umesinyaa, wala hakuweza kuutumia.

vi.L: Và kìa, [có] một người có bàn tay bị teo.
vi.B: Ở đó có một người bị teo một bàn tay.
vi.R: Ở đó có một người bị tật ở tay: bàn tay ấy khô teo, không cử động được.

ko.L: 그리고 보라, 손이 마른 사람이 [있었다].
ko.B: 거기에 손이 오그라든 사람이 하나 있었다.
ko.R: 거기에 한쪽 손이 오그라들어서 쓰지 못하는 사람이 있었다.

decisions.choice: withered: dried up and shrunken, so that it could not be used
decisions.reason: The word means dry. It is used of a hand that cannot move (1 Kings 13:4).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:20, Literal uses "look" and Balanced and Readable carry the word's force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: he aquí (L); seca (L, R), atrofiada (B)
decisions.reason: "He aquí" is the Spanish way to point at something in a story; "mira" would sound as if someone were being spoken to. "Atrofiada" says that the hand was shrunken and useless (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: uliokauka (L); umesinyaa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The hand was dried up and shrunken (meaning decision m1). "Kukauka" keeps the Greek picture of drying; "kusinyaa" is to shrivel. "Kupooza" would describe paralysis, a different condition.

decisions.choice: "bị teo" (L, B); "khô teo, không cử động được" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 3:1: dried up and shrunken, so that it could not be used (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "마른" (L); "오그라든" (B); "오그라들어서 쓰지 못하는" (R)
decisions.reason: Withered means dried up and shrunken so that it could not be used (meaning decision); as in the Korean Mark 3:1, Balanced says what it looked like and Readable adds what it meant.

source.text: καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες· Εἰ ἔξεστι τοῖς σάββασιν θεραπεύειν;

records.literal_gloss: And they asked him saying, If it is lawful on the Sabbaths to heal?

en.L: And they questioned {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"
en.B: They put a question to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: "Is healing allowed on the Sabbath?"
en.R: Some Pharisees were there. They asked Jesus, "Does our law allow anyone to heal on the Sabbath?"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron, diciendo: «¿Es lícito sanar en sábado?».
es.B: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «¿Se permite sanar en sábado?».
es.R: Había allí algunos fariseos. Le preguntaron a Jesús: «¿Permite nuestra ley sanar a alguien en sábado?».

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}interrogèrent, disant : « Est-il permis de guérir le jour du sabbat ? »
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} posèrent cette question : « Est-il permis de guérir quelqu’un le jour du sabbat ? »
fr.R: Il y avait aussi des Pharisiens. Ils ont demandé à Jésus : « Est-ce que notre Loi permet de guérir quelqu’un le jour du sabbat ? »

sw.L: Nao wakamwuliza, wakisema, "Je, ni halali kuponya katika Sabato?"
sw.B: Wakamwuliza swali, "Je, inaruhusiwa kuponya siku ya Sabato?"
sw.R: Baadhi ya Mafarisayo walikuwepo pale. Wakamwuliza Yesu, "Je, sheria yetu inaruhusu mtu kuponya siku ya Sabato?"

vi.L: Và họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: "Có được phép chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát không?"
vi.B: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Luật pháp có cho phép chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát không?"
vi.R: Có mấy người Pha-ri-si ở đó. Họ hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Luật pháp của chúng ta có cho phép chữa bệnh trong ngày Sa-bát không?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그분께 물어 말했다. "안식일에 병을 고치는 것이 허락됩니까?"
ko.B: 사람들이 예수께 물었다. "안식일에 병을 고쳐도 됩니까?"
ko.R: 바리새파 사람들도 거기에 있었다. 그들이 예수께 물었다. "우리 율법은 안식일에 병을 고치는 것을 허락합니까?"

decisions.choice: if: here it introduces a direct question
decisions.reason: In the Greek of this time the word for "if" can begin a question.

decisions.choice: healing on the Sabbath: debated
alternatives: clearly forbidden by the law of Moses
decisions.reason: The law of Moses does not mention healing on the Sabbath. Later Jewish teaching allowed it when a life was in danger; this man's life was not.

decisions.choice: on the Sabbath: one Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The Greek often uses the plural for a single Sabbath day.

decisions.choice: Some Pharisees
decisions.reason: The questioners are the Pharisees, as 12:14 shows. Readable names them.

decisions.choice: "바리새파 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The questioners are the Pharisees of 12:2 and 12:14; Readable names them, as the English Readable does. They ask in 합쇼체, as in 12:2.

source.text: ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: so that they might accuse him.

en.L: so that they might accuse {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: They wanted a reason to bring a charge against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: They were hoping to find a reason to accuse {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} acusaran.
es.B: Buscaban un motivo para presentar una acusación contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Querían encontrar una razón para acusar{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

fr.L: afin de {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accuser.
fr.B: Ils cherchaient un motif pour porter une accusation contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Ils espéraient trouver une raison de {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accuser.

sw.L: ili wapate kumshtaki.
sw.B: Walitaka kupata sababu ya kumshtaki.
sw.R: Walikuwa wakitumaini kupata sababu ya kumshtaki.

vi.L: để tố cáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Họ muốn có cớ để tố cáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Họ đang tìm lý do để tố cáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분을 고발하려는 것이었다.
ko.B: 예수를 고발할 구실을 찾으려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 예수를 고발할 구실을 찾으려는 것이었다.

decisions.choice: accuse: bring a formal charge
decisions.reason: The verb is used of bringing a charge before judges. Breaking the Sabbath was a serious offense under the law (Exodus 31:14).

decisions.choice: "고발하다"
decisions.reason: To accuse is to bring a formal charge (meaning decision), as in the Korean Mark 3:2.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τίς ἔσται ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἕξει πρόβατον ἕν, καὶ ἐὰν ἐμπέσῃ τοῦτο τοῖς σάββασιν εἰς βόθυνον, οὐχὶ κρατήσει αὐτὸ καὶ ἐγερεῖ;

records.literal_gloss: He but said to them, What man will be of you who will have sheep one, and if falls this on the Sabbaths into a pit, not will take hold of it and raise?

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "What {{gender:person|man}} will there be among you who has one sheep, and if it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will not take hold of it and lift [it] out?
en.B: He answered them, "Suppose one of you has just one sheep, and it falls into a hole on the Sabbath. Will you not grab hold of it and pull it out?
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Suppose one of you has only one sheep, and it falls into a deep hole on the Sabbath. You will surely grab it and pull it out.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¿Qué {{gender:persona|hombre}} habrá entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que tenga una oveja, y si esta cae en un hoyo en sábado, no la agarrará y la sacará?
es.B: Él les respondió: «Supongamos que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tiene una sola oveja y se le cae en un hoyo en sábado. ¿No la agarrará y la sacará?
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Supongamos que uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} tiene solo una oveja, y un sábado se le cae en un pozo hondo. Seguro que la agarra y la saca.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Qui d’entre vous, ayant une seule brebis, si elle tombe dans une fosse le jour du sabbat, ne la saisira pas et ne la relèvera pas ?
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Supposons que l’un de vous n’ait qu’une seule brebis et qu’elle tombe dans un trou le jour du sabbat. Ne va-t-il pas la saisir et l’en sortir ?
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Imaginez que l’un de vous a une seule brebis, et qu’elle tombe dans un trou profond le jour du sabbat. Vous allez sûrement l’attraper et la sortir de là.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akawaambia, "Ni mtu gani kati yenu aliye na kondoo mmoja, naye akitumbukia shimoni katika Sabato, hatamshika na kumwinua?
sw.B: Akawajibu, "Tuseme mmoja wenu ana kondoo mmoja tu, naye akatumbukia shimoni siku ya Sabato. Je, hatamshika na kumtoa?
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Tuseme mmoja wenu ana kondoo mmoja tu, naye akaanguka katika shimo refu siku ya Sabato. Hakika atamshika na kumtoa nje.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Trong các người, ai có một con chiên, nếu nó rơi xuống hố trong ngày Sa-bát, lại không nắm lấy nó mà kéo lên sao?
vi.B: Ngài đáp: "Giả sử trong các người có ai chỉ có một con chiên, và nó rơi xuống hố vào ngày Sa-bát. Người ấy lại không nắm lấy nó mà kéo lên sao?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Giả sử một người trong các người chỉ có một con chiên, và nó rơi xuống một cái hố sâu vào ngày Sa-bát. Chắc chắn người ấy sẽ nắm lấy nó và kéo nó lên.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 어떤 사람이 양 한 마리를 가지고 있는데, 그것이 안식일에 구덩이에 빠지면, 그것을 붙잡아 끌어 올리지 않겠느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 누가 양 한 마리를 가지고 있는데, 그 양이 안식일에 구덩이에 빠졌다고 하자. 그 사람이 양을 붙잡아 끌어 올리지 않겠느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희 가운데 누가 양 한 마리만 가지고 있는데, 그 양이 안식일에 깊은 구덩이에 빠졌다고 하자. 그 사람은 틀림없이 양을 붙잡아 끌어 올릴 것이다.

decisions.choice: rescuing an animal on the Sabbath: what his hearers would do
alternatives: a rule all Jews agreed on
decisions.reason: Jewish groups disagreed about this. The Damascus Document found at Qumran forbids lifting an animal out of a pit on the Sabbath. Jesus appeals to what his hearers themselves would do.

decisions.choice: one sheep: perhaps the only one the man owns
alternatives: one sheep out of a flock
decisions.reason: The number stresses how much the loss would matter to him.

decisions.choice: on the Sabbath: one Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The Greek often uses the plural for a single Sabbath day.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
alternatives: Will you not lift it out?
decisions.reason: The question expects "yes"; Readable gives the answer.

decisions.choice: Qui d’entre vous (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: English Literal puts "person / man" under the gender setting. French says the same idiom with the generic pronoun "qui d’entre vous", which already means anyone and so takes no span (style guide §7).

decisions.choice: mtu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "man" as the traditional alternative to "person". "Mtu" already means anyone, man or woman, so Swahili needs no span.

decisions.choice: "ai", "người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai" (who, anyone) already includes men and women, so the English Literal span on "person/man" has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "어떤 사람" and "누가" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" and "누가" already include men and women, so the English gender span has nothing to change in Korean.

source.text: πόσῳ οὖν διαφέρει ἄνθρωπος προβάτου.

records.literal_gloss: By how much then is worth more a man than a sheep.

en.L: How much more valuable then is a human being than a sheep!
en.B: And a human being is worth far more than a sheep!
en.R: And a person is worth much more than a sheep!

es.L: ¡Cuánto más vale, pues, un ser humano que una oveja!
es.B: ¡Y una persona vale mucho más que una oveja!
es.R: ¡Y una persona vale muchísimo más que una oveja!

fr.L: Combien donc un être humain vaut-il plus qu’une brebis !
fr.B: Or un être humain vaut bien plus qu’une brebis !
fr.R: Et une personne vaut beaucoup plus qu’une brebis !

sw.L: Basi mwanadamu ana thamani zaidi kiasi gani kuliko kondoo!
sw.B: Na binadamu ana thamani kubwa zaidi kuliko kondoo!
sw.R: Na mtu ana thamani kubwa sana kuliko kondoo!

vi.L: Vậy, một con người quý hơn một con chiên biết bao!
vi.B: Mà con người thì quý hơn con chiên biết bao!
vi.R: Mà một người thì quý hơn một con chiên nhiều lắm!

ko.L: 그러니 사람이 양보다 얼마나 더 귀하냐!
ko.B: 하물며 사람은 양보다 훨씬 더 귀하지 않으냐!
ko.R: 사람은 양보다 훨씬 더 귀하다!

decisions.choice: an exclamation, from the lesser to the greater
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates it as a statement. If a sheep may be rescued, how much more a person (6:26; 10:31).

source.text: ὥστε ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν καλῶς ποιεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: So that it is lawful on the Sabbaths well to do.

en.L: So it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."
en.B: So the law allows doing good on the Sabbath."
en.R: So the law allows people to do good things on the Sabbath."

es.L: Así que es lícito hacer el bien en sábado».
es.B: Por tanto, la ley permite hacer el bien en sábado».
es.R: Así que la ley permite que la gente haga cosas buenas en sábado».

fr.L: Ainsi, il est permis de faire du bien le jour du sabbat. »
fr.B: La Loi permet donc de faire du bien le jour du sabbat. »
fr.R: La Loi permet donc de faire de bonnes choses le jour du sabbat. »

sw.L: Hivyo ni halali kufanya mema katika Sabato."
sw.B: Kwa hiyo sheria inaruhusu kutenda mema siku ya Sabato."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo sheria inawaruhusu watu kufanya mambo mazuri siku ya Sabato."

vi.L: Vậy, được phép làm điều lành trong ngày Sa-bát."
vi.B: Vậy, luật pháp cho phép làm điều lành trong ngày Sa-bát."
vi.R: Vậy, luật pháp cho phép người ta làm điều tốt trong ngày Sa-bát."

ko.L: 그러므로 안식일에 선을 행하는 것은 허락되어 있다."
ko.B: 그러므로 율법은 안식일에 선한 일을 하는 것을 허락한다."
ko.R: 그러니 율법은 안식일에도 사람들이 좋은 일을 하도록 허락한다."

decisions.choice: to do good: to act rightly and help others
decisions.reason: The phrase means to do what is right and kind, here by healing.

decisions.choice: on the Sabbath: one Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The Greek often uses the plural for a single Sabbath day.

decisions.choice: "선을 행하다" (L), "선한 일을 하다" (B), "좋은 일을 하다" (R)
decisions.reason: To do good is to act rightly and help others (meaning decision), as in the Korean Mark 3:4.

source.text: τότε λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ· Ἔκτεινόν σου τὴν χεῖρα· καὶ ἐξέτεινεν, καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ὑγιὴς ὡς ἡ ἄλλη.

records.literal_gloss: Then he says to the man, Stretch out of you the hand; and he stretched out, and it was restored healthy as the other.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched [it] out, and it was restored, healthy like the other.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told the man, "Hold out your hand." The man held it out, and it was made well again, just like his other hand.
en.R: Then Jesus said to the man, "Hold out your hand." The man held out his hand, and it became healthy again. It was just like his other hand.

es.L: Entonces dice al hombre: «Extiende tu mano». Y [la] extendió, y fue restaurada, sana como la otra.
es.B: Entonces le dijo al hombre: «Extiende la mano». El hombre la extendió, y la mano le quedó sana otra vez, igual que la otra.
es.R: Entonces Jesús le dijo al hombre: «Extiende la mano». El hombre extendió la mano, y quedó sana de nuevo. Estaba igual que su otra mano.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit à l’homme : « Étends ta main. » Et il [l’]étendit, et elle fut rendue saine comme l’autre.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit à l’homme : « Tends la main. » L’homme la tendit, et elle redevint saine, tout comme l’autre.
fr.R: Puis Jésus a dit à l’homme : « Tends la main. » L’homme a tendu la main, et elle est redevenue saine. Elle était exactement comme son autre main.

sw.L: Kisha anamwambia yule mtu, "Nyoosha mkono wako." Naye akaunyoosha, nao ukarudishwa ukawa mzima kama ule mwingine.
sw.B: Kisha akamwambia yule mtu, "Nyoosha mkono wako." Akaunyoosha, nao ukawa mzima tena, sawa kabisa na mkono wake mwingine.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akamwambia yule mtu, "Nyoosha mkono wako." Yule mtu akaunyoosha mkono wake, nao ukapona. Ukawa sawa na mkono wake mwingine.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với người ấy: "Hãy giơ tay ra." Và người ấy giơ ra, và tay được phục hồi, lành mạnh như tay kia.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo người ấy: "Hãy giơ tay ra." Người ấy giơ tay ra, và tay ấy được lành lại, giống như tay kia.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với người ấy: "Hãy giơ tay ra." Người ấy giơ tay ra, và bàn tay được lành lại. Nó giống hệt như bàn tay kia.

ko.L: 그때 그분이 그 사람에게 말씀하신다. "네 손을 내밀어라." 그러자 그가 내밀었고, [그 손이] 다른 손처럼 성하게 회복되었다.
ko.B: 그리고 예수께서 그 사람에게 말씀하셨다. "손을 내밀어라." 그 사람이 손을 내밀자, 그 손이 다른 손처럼 다시 성해졌다.
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 그 사람에게 말씀하셨다. "손을 내밀어라." 그 사람이 손을 내밀자, 손이 나았다. 다른 손과 똑같이 멀쩡해졌다.

decisions.choice: it was restored: God's work through Jesus's word
decisions.reason: Jesus heals by a word alone. The passive points to God as the one who restores.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: no span where Spanish leaves out the subject pronoun
decisions.reason: Where the English marks "he" for Jesus, Spanish usually needs no pronoun at all ("dice", "le dijo"), so there is nothing to capitalise. Spanish has spans only where it writes the pronoun (él, lo, le, su), as here and throughout the passage.

decisions.choice: "nói" with no "đã" (L) for the historic present "says"
decisions.reason: As in 9:28.

decisions.choice: historic present kept in Literal ("말씀하신다"); past in Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: As docs/korean-style.md section 3 asks.

source.text: ἐξελθόντες δὲ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συμβούλιον ἔλαβον κατ’ αὐτοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Having gone out but the Pharisees counsel took against him how him they might destroy.

en.L: But the Pharisees went out and took counsel against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, how they might destroy {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: The Pharisees left and met together to plot against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, looking for a way to put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to death.
en.R: Then the Pharisees went out and met together. They made plans to kill Jesus.

es.L: Pero los fariseos, saliendo, se reunieron en consejo contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, [para ver] cómo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} destruirían.
es.B: Los fariseos salieron y se reunieron para conspirar contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, buscando cómo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} podrían matar.
es.R: Entonces los fariseos salieron y se reunieron. Hicieron planes para matar a Jesús.

fr.L: Mais les Pharisiens, étant sortis, tinrent conseil contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sur la manière de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire périr.
fr.B: Les Pharisiens sortirent et se réunirent pour comploter contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; ils cherchaient un moyen de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire mourir.
fr.R: Alors les Pharisiens sont sortis et se sont réunis. Ils ont fait des plans pour tuer Jésus.

sw.L: Lakini Mafarisayo walitoka nje, wakafanya shauri dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, jinsi watakavyomwangamiza.
sw.B: Mafarisayo walitoka nje, wakakutana kupanga njama dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, wakitafuta njia ya kumwua.
sw.R: Kisha Mafarisayo walitoka nje, wakakutana pamoja. Wakapanga mipango ya kumwua Yesu.

vi.L: Nhưng những người Pha-ri-si đi ra và bàn mưu chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tìm cách giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Những người Pha-ri-si ra về và họp nhau bàn mưu chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tìm cách giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi những người Pha-ri-si đi ra và họp nhau lại. Họ bàn kế hoạch để giết Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그러나 바리새파 사람들은 나가서, 어떻게 하면 그분을 없앨 수 있을지 그분을 거슬러 의논하였다.
ko.B: 바리새파 사람들은 밖으로 나가서, 어떻게 하면 예수를 죽일 수 있을지 함께 모의하였다.
ko.R: 그러자 바리새파 사람들이 밖으로 나가서 함께 모였다. 그들은 예수를 죽일 계획을 세웠다.

decisions.choice: destroy: kill
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of Herod seeking to kill the child Jesus (2:13). This is the first plot against Jesus's life by the leaders.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus.

decisions.choice: "없애다" (L); "죽이다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Destroy here means kill (meaning decision); Literal keeps a general verb as in the Korean Mark 3:6, and Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

source.text: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς γνοὺς ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν.

records.literal_gloss: The but Jesus having known withdrew from there.

en.L: But Jesus, knowing [it], withdrew from there.
en.B: Jesus knew what they were planning, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} withdrew from there.
en.R: Jesus knew about their plan, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left that place.

es.L: Pero Jesús, conociendo [esto], se retiró de allí.
es.B: Jesús supo lo que estaban tramando, y se retiró de allí.
es.R: Jesús se enteró de su plan, así que se fue de aquel lugar.

fr.L: Mais Jésus, l’ayant su, se retira de là.
fr.B: Jésus sut ce qu’ils préparaient, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se retira de là.
fr.R: Jésus a appris ce qu’ils voulaient faire. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est parti de cet endroit.

sw.L: Lakini Yesu, akijua [hilo], akaondoka pale.
sw.B: Yesu alijua walichokuwa wakipanga, akaondoka mahali pale.
sw.R: Yesu alijua kuhusu mpango wao, kwa hiyo akaondoka mahali pale.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu biết [điều đó] nên rời khỏi nơi ấy.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu biết họ đang âm mưu, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi nơi ấy.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu biết kế hoạch của họ, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi nơi đó.

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 [이것을] 아시고 거기에서 물러가셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 그들의 계획을 아시고 그곳을 떠나 물러가셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 그들의 계획을 아셨다. 그래서 그곳을 떠나셨다.

decisions.choice: withdrew: went away from danger
decisions.reason: Matthew uses this verb when Jesus or his family moves away from a threat (2:14, 22; 4:12; 14:13).

decisions.choice: what they were planning (B); about their plan (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what Jesus knew.

source.text: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς πάντας, καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μὴ φανερὸν αὐτὸν ποιήσωσιν, ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος·

records.literal_gloss: And followed him many, and he healed them all, \v 16 and he warned them that not known him they should make, \v 17 so that might be fulfilled the spoken through Isaiah the prophet saying,

en.L: And many followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed them all, \v 16 and warned them that they should not make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} known, \v 17 so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, saying,
en.B: Many people followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed every one of them. \v 16 But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} ordered them not to tell others who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was. \v 17 This was so that the word spoken through the prophet Isaiah would be fulfilled:
en.R: Many people followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed all of them. \v 16 But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} warned them not to tell anyone about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 17 This made what the prophet Isaiah had said come true:

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} siguieron muchos, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los sanó a todos, \v 16 y les advirtió que no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} dieran a conocer, \v 17 para que se cumpliera lo dicho por medio de Isaías el profeta, que dice:
es.B: Mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} siguió, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sanó a todos. \v 16 Pero les ordenó que no dijeran a otros quién era. \v 17 Esto sucedió para que se cumpliera lo que se había dicho por medio del profeta Isaías:
es.R: Mucha gente {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} siguió, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los sanó a todos. \v 16 Pero les advirtió que no hablaran con nadie acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 17 Así se hizo realidad lo que había dicho el profeta Isaías:

fr.L: Et beaucoup {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivirent, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les guérit tous, \v 16 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ordonna sévèrement de ne pas {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire connaître, \v 17 afin que s’accomplisse ce qui avait été dit par le prophète Isaïe, qui disait :
fr.B: Beaucoup de gens {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivirent, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les guérit tous. \v 16 Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur ordonna de ne pas dire aux autres qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était. \v 17 Il en fut ainsi pour que s’accomplisse la parole annoncée par le prophète Isaïe :
fr.R: Beaucoup de gens {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont suivi, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a tous guéris. \v 16 Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a ordonné de ne parler de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à personne. \v 17 Ainsi, ce que le prophète Isaïe avait dit s’est réalisé :

sw.L: Na wengi wakamfuata, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawaponya wote, \v 16 akawaonya wasimdhihirishe, \v 17 ili litimie lile lililonenwa kupitia Isaya nabii, akisema,
sw.B: Watu wengi walimfuata, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawaponya wote. \v 16 Lakini akawaagiza wasiwaambie wengine {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni nani. \v 17 Hii ilikuwa ili litimie neno lililosemwa kupitia nabii Isaya:
sw.R: Watu wengi walimfuata, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawaponya wote. \v 16 Lakini akawaonya wasimwambie mtu yeyote habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \v 17 Hivyo yakatimia yale aliyosema nabii Isaya:

vi.L: Và nhiều người đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành tất cả họ, \v 16 và nghiêm dặn họ đừng làm cho người ta biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 17 để được ứng nghiệm lời đã phán qua tiên tri Ê-sai rằng:
vi.B: Có nhiều người đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành hết thảy họ. \v 16 Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiêm dặn họ đừng nói cho ai biết về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 17 Như vậy là ứng nghiệm lời đã phán qua nhà tiên tri Ê-sai:
vi.R: Rất nhiều người đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành tất cả họ. \v 16 Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dặn họ đừng nói với ai về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 17 Việc này làm cho lời nhà tiên tri Ê-sai đã nói trở thành sự thật:

ko.L: 그리고 많은 사람이 그분을 따랐고, 그분은 그들을 모두 고치셨다. \v 16 그리고 자기를 드러내지 말라고 그들에게 엄하게 경고하셨다. \v 17 이는 이사야 예언자를 통하여 하신 말씀이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었다. [그 말씀은] 이러하다.
ko.B: 많은 사람이 예수를 따라왔고, 예수께서는 그들을 모두 고쳐 주셨다. \v 16 그리고 자기가 누구인지 알리지 말라고 그들에게 엄하게 이르셨다. \v 17 이것은 이사야 예언자를 통하여 하신 이 말씀을 이루시려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 많은 사람이 예수를 따라왔다. 예수께서는 그들을 모두 고쳐 주셨다. \v 16 그러나 자기에 대해 아무에게도 말하지 말라고 그들에게 경고하셨다. \v 17 이렇게 해서 이사야 예언자를 통해 하신 말씀이 이루어졌다.

decisions.choice: not to make him known: Jesus does not seek fame
alternatives: he wanted to keep the healings secret from the Pharisees only
decisions.reason: Matthew explains the command by the quotation that follows: God's servant does not shout or push himself forward (12:19).

alternatives: many crowds, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "many crowds". The meaning is the same. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.reason: The formula that introduces a fulfilled prophecy is given in the same words each time.

decisions.choice: Isaïe
decisions.reason: "Isaïe" is the form of general French usage, used throughout this translation's French; "Ésaïe" is the Protestant form.

decisions.choice: "để được ứng nghiệm lời đã phán qua tiên tri Ê-sai" (L); B and R as in 8:17
decisions.reason: The same formula as 8:17, worded the same way at each level, as the English Balanced decision asks.
