decisions.reason: Matthew repeats the formula, so the Korean does; "하신 말씀" carries with the honorific that God spoke through the prophet.

source.text: Ἰδοὺ ὁ παῖς μου ὃν ᾑρέτισα, ὁ ἀγαπητός μου εἰς ὃν εὐδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου· θήσω τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπ’ αὐτόν, καὶ κρίσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἀπαγγελεῖ.

records.literal_gloss: Behold the servant of me whom I chose, the beloved of me in whom was well pleased the soul of me; I will put the Spirit of me upon him, and justice to the Gentiles he will proclaim.

en.L: "Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant whom I have chosen, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beloved in whom {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul is well pleased; I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit upon {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will proclaim justice to the Gentiles.
en.B: "See {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, the one I have chosen, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dearly loved one, in whom {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul delights. I will place {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make justice known to the Gentiles.
en.R: "Here is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant. I have chosen {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. I love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and I am very pleased with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Spirit on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He will announce justice to people of every nation.

es.L: «He aquí {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, al que elegí, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amado, en quien {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma se complació; pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} proclamará justicia a los gentiles.
es.B: «Aquí está {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, el que he escogido, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amado, en quien {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma se deleita. Sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dará a conocer la justicia a los gentiles.
es.R: «Aquí está {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo. Yo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} he elegido. Yo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} amo, y estoy muy contento con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Espíritu sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Él anunciará la justicia a la gente de todas las naciones.

fr.L: « Voici {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, que j’ai choisi, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} bien-aimé, en qui {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme a pris plaisir ; je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} annoncera la justice aux nations.
fr.B: « Voici {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, celui que j’ai choisi, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} bien-aimé, en qui {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme trouve sa joie. Je placerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera connaître la justice aux non-Juifs.
fr.R: « Voici {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur. Je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ai choisi. Je {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aime, et je suis très content de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Esprit sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il annoncera la justice aux gens de toutes les nations.

sw.L: "Tazama, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} niliyemchagua, mpendwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ambaye nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} imefurahishwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}; nitaweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atatangaza haki kwa watu wa mataifa.
sw.B: "Huyu hapa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, yule niliyemchagua, mpendwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, ambaye nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inapendezwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} sana. Nitaweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawajulisha watu wa mataifa haki.
sw.R: "Huyu ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nimemchagua. Ninampenda, na ninafurahishwa sana {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Nitaweka Roho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Atatangaza haki kwa watu wa kila taifa.

vi.L: "Kìa, đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn, người yêu dấu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là người mà linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đẹp lòng; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}, và {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} sẽ công bố công lý cho các dân ngoại.
vi.B: "Đây là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn, người yêu dấu mà lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vui thích. {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}, và {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} sẽ công bố công lý cho các dân ngoại.
vi.R: "Đây là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta đã chọn {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}. Ta yêu thương {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rất hài lòng về {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}. Ta sẽ đặt Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}. Người sẽ công bố công lý cho mọi dân tộc.

ko.L: "보라, 내가 택한 나의 종, 내 영혼이 기뻐하는 나의 사랑하는 자이다. 내가 내 영을 그 위에 둘 것이니, 그가 이방 사람들에게 정의를 선포할 것이다.
ko.B: "보라, 내가 택한 나의 종이다. 내가 사랑하는 자, 내 마음이 기뻐하는 자이다. 내가 내 영을 그에게 줄 것이니, 그가 이방 사람들에게 정의를 알릴 것이다.
ko.R: "여기 내 종이 있다. 내가 그를 택했다. 나는 그를 사랑하고, 그를 몹시 기뻐한다. 내가 내 영을 그에게 줄 것이다. 그가 모든 민족에게 정의를 전할 것이다.

decisions.choice: Isaiah 42:1-4: the servant of the LORD
alternatives: a general saying about God's people
decisions.reason: Matthew quotes the passage in a form of his own, close to neither the Hebrew nor the Greek Old Testament throughout. Where Isaiah has "my chosen", Matthew has "my beloved", the word of the voice at Jesus's baptism (3:17; see 17:5).

decisions.choice: servant: the servant of God in Isaiah
decisions.reason: The word can mean child or servant. Isaiah's servant is meant, and Matthew sees him in Jesus.

decisions.choice: justice: the right order God establishes
decisions.reason: The word can mean judgment. In Isaiah 42 it is the just rule the servant brings, even to the nations.

decisions.choice: spans on "my" for God and on "he" and "him" for the servant
decisions.reason: God speaks here, and the servant is Jesus, so the pronouns for both take the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: look (L), here is (B, R); Gentiles (L, B), people of every nation (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced introduces the servant as a herald would. Readable says who the Gentiles are.

decisions.choice: justicia
decisions.reason: The word here is the right order God sets up (meaning decision m3), not a court's verdict, so Spanish says "justicia" rather than "juicio", which today means a trial.

decisions.choice: les nations (L); les non-Juifs (B); les gens de toutes les nations (R), here and in 12:21
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms: Literal keeps the word "nations", Balanced says "non-Juifs" where the English says "Gentiles", and Readable follows the English "people of every nation". "Les païens" would say "pagans", a judgment the word does not carry here.

decisions.choice: haki
decisions.reason: The word here is the right order God sets up (meaning decision m3), so Swahili says "haki" (justice, what is right) rather than "hukumu", which is a court's judgment or sentence.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} for the servant; God says "Ta" with the setting
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 42:1-4 God speaks of his servant, whom Matthew sees in Jesus (meaning decision), and the English puts the setting on "he" and "him". Vietnamese "Ngài" would have God honour his servant above himself; "người", the third-person pronoun of respect, fits God speaking and still carries the capitalised setting for those who want it. Through 12:21. A reviewer should check this choice.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ" for "servant"; "công lý" for "justice"
decisions.reason: The servant of God in Isaiah (meaning decision): pais here is not doulos, so "đầy tớ" at every level. Justice is the right order God establishes (meaning decision); "công lý" is kept apart from "sự công chính", the key term for righteousness.

decisions.choice: God speaks in 해라체 and calls the servant "그", with no honorific; "종" for pais
decisions.reason: In Isaiah 42:1-4 God speaks of his servant (meaning decision), and Korean has the speaker give the honorific, so God's own words keep the plain "그", as the Korean Matthew 8:17 does in Isaiah 53. The reader knows the servant is Jesus from 12:17; the narrative's honorific for Jesus resumes after the quotation.

decisions.choice: "정의" for krisis; "이방 사람들" (L, B), "모든 민족" (R)
decisions.reason: Justice is the right order God establishes (meaning decision); "정의" is the current word, where "공의" is older and "심판" would say judgment. Readable says "every nation", as the English Readable does.

source.text: οὐκ ἐρίσει οὐδὲ κραυγάσει, οὐδὲ ἀκούσει τις ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Not will he quarrel nor cry out, nor will hear anyone in the streets the voice of him.

en.L: He will not quarrel nor shout, nor will anyone hear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice in the broad streets.
en.B: He will not quarrel or shout; no one will hear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} raising {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice in the streets.
en.R: He will not argue with people or shout at them. No one will hear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} shouting in the streets.

es.L: No disputará ni gritará, ni oirá nadie {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz en las calles anchas.
es.B: No discutirá ni gritará; nadie {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oirá alzar la voz en las calles.
es.R: No discutirá con la gente ni les gritará. Nadie {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oirá gritar en las calles.

fr.L: Il ne se querellera pas et ne criera pas, et personne n’entendra {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix dans les grandes rues.
fr.B: Il ne cherchera pas querelle, il ne criera pas ; personne ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entendra élever la voix dans les rues.
fr.R: Il ne se disputera pas avec les gens et ne criera pas contre eux. Personne ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entendra crier dans les rues.

sw.L: Hatabishana wala hatapiga kelele, wala hakuna mtu atakayesikia sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika njia kuu.
sw.B: Hatagombana wala hatapiga kelele; hakuna atakayemsikia akipaza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} barabarani.
sw.R: Hatabishana na watu wala kuwapigia kelele. Hakuna mtu atakayemsikia akipiga kelele barabarani.

vi.L: Người sẽ không cãi cọ, cũng không la lối, và không ai nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} ngoài các đường phố.
vi.B: Người sẽ không tranh cãi, không la lối; không ai nghe {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} lớn tiếng ngoài đường phố.
vi.R: Người sẽ không cãi vã với ai, cũng không la hét. Không ai nghe {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} la lớn ngoài đường phố.

ko.L: 그는 다투지도 않고 소리치지도 않을 것이니, 아무도 넓은 거리에서 그의 소리를 듣지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 다투지도 않고 소리치지도 않을 것이다. 아무도 거리에서 그가 목소리를 높이는 것을 듣지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 사람들과 다투거나 그들에게 소리치지 않을 것이다. 아무도 거리에서 그가 소리 지르는 것을 듣지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: quarrel, cry out: the servant does not fight or push himself forward
decisions.reason: Matthew sees this in Jesus's withdrawal and his command not to make him known (12:15-16).

decisions.choice: the streets: the wide, public streets of a town
decisions.reason: The word means the broad streets where people gathered and speakers drew crowds.

source.text: κάλαμον συντετριμμένον οὐ κατεάξει καὶ λίνον τυφόμενον οὐ σβέσει, ἕως ἂν ἐκβάλῃ εἰς νῖκος τὴν κρίσιν.

records.literal_gloss: A reed bruised not he will break and a wick smoldering not he will quench, until he brings out to victory the justice.

en.L: A crushed reed {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not break, and a smoldering wick {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not put out, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings justice forth to victory.
en.B: He will not snap off a bent reed or snuff out a wick that is barely burning, until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has led justice on to victory.
en.R: He will not break off a reed that is bent. He will not put out a lamp wick that is barely burning. He will be like this until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes justice win.

es.L: Una caña aplastada no quebrará, y una mecha que humea no apagará, hasta que lleve la justicia a la victoria.
es.B: No acabará de romper la caña doblada ni apagará la mecha que apenas arde, hasta que haya llevado la justicia a la victoria.
es.R: No terminará de romper una caña que está doblada. No apagará la mecha de una lámpara que apenas arde. Así actuará hasta que haga triunfar la justicia.

fr.L: Le roseau broyé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne le brisera pas, et la mèche qui fume, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne l’éteindra pas, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mène la justice à la victoire.
fr.B: Il ne cassera pas le roseau plié, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’éteindra pas la mèche qui brûle à peine, jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait conduit la justice à la victoire.
fr.R: Il ne cassera pas un roseau qui est plié. Il n’éteindra pas la mèche d’une lampe qui brûle à peine. Il agira ainsi jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse triompher la justice.

sw.L: Tete lililopondwa hatalivunja, na utambi unaofuka moshi hatauzima, mpaka aipeleke haki kwenye ushindi.
sw.B: Hatalivunja tete lililopindika, wala hatauzima utambi unaowaka kwa shida, mpaka atakapoiongoza haki hadi ishinde.
sw.R: Hatalivunja tete lililopindika. Hatauzima utambi wa taa unaowaka kidogo tu. Atakuwa hivyo mpaka aifanye haki ishinde.

vi.L: Cây sậy bị giập, {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} sẽ không bẻ gãy, và tim đèn còn đang bốc khói, {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} sẽ không dập tắt, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} đem công lý đến chỗ toàn thắng.
vi.B: Người sẽ không bẻ gãy cây sậy đã bị giập, không dập tắt tim đèn sắp tàn, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} đưa công lý đến chỗ toàn thắng.
vi.R: Người sẽ không bẻ gãy cây sậy đã bị cong. Người sẽ không dập tắt tim đèn sắp tắt. Người sẽ làm như vậy cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}} làm cho công lý thắng.

ko.L: 그는 상한 갈대를 꺾지 않고, 연기 나는 심지를 끄지 않을 것이다. 정의를 이끌어 내어 승리하게 할 때까지 [그럴 것이다].
ko.B: 그는 상한 갈대를 꺾지 않고, 꺼져 가는 심지를 끄지 않을 것이다. 마침내 정의를 승리로 이끌 때까지 그렇게 할 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 휘어진 갈대를 꺾어 버리지 않을 것이다. 거의 꺼져 가는 등잔 심지도 끄지 않을 것이다. 그는 정의가 이기게 할 때까지 그렇게 할 것이다.

decisions.choice: the crushed reed and the smoldering wick: people who are weak and failing
decisions.reason: The servant does not finish off those who are bent or almost spent. He is gentle with them (see 11:28-29).

decisions.choice: until he brings justice to victory: Isaiah 42:3-4 in brief
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the servant will bring out justice faithfully and not grow faint until he has set justice in the earth. Matthew sums this up.

decisions.choice: victory: success, the final triumph of justice
decisions.reason: The servant's gentleness is not weakness; justice will win in the end.

decisions.choice: He will be like this until
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence and joins the last clause to what comes before.

decisions.choice: mecha
decisions.reason: "Pábilo" is the older word and few readers now know it; "mecha" is the wick of any lamp or candle.

decisions.choice: "cây sậy bị giập", "tim đèn còn đang bốc khói" (L)
decisions.reason: The pictures stand for people who are weak and failing (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps them as pictures, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "[그럴 것이다]" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean puts a clause of "until" before its main verb; to keep Isaiah's order, Literal makes it a sentence of its own and supplies the verb in brackets. The reed and the wick are people who are weak and failing (meaning decision); the Korean keeps the picture.

source.text: καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.

records.literal_gloss: And in the name of him Gentiles will hope.

en.L: And in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name [the] Gentiles will hope."
en.B: And the Gentiles will put their hope in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name."
en.R: People of every nation will put their hope in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre tendrán esperanza [los] gentiles».
es.B: Y los gentiles pondrán su esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre».
es.R: La gente de todas las naciones pondrá su esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

fr.L: Et en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom les nations espéreront. »
fr.B: Et les non-Juifs mettront leur espérance en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. »
fr.R: Les gens de toutes les nations mettront leur espoir en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »

sw.L: Na katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} watu wa mataifa watatumaini."
sw.B: Na watu wa mataifa wataweka tumaini lao katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}."
sw.R: Watu wa kila taifa wataweka tumaini lao {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}."

vi.L: Và các dân ngoại sẽ hy vọng nơi danh {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}."
vi.B: Các dân ngoại sẽ đặt hy vọng nơi danh {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}."
vi.R: Mọi dân tộc sẽ đặt hy vọng nơi {{deity_pronoun:người|Người}}."

ko.L: 그리고 그의 이름에 이방 사람들이 소망을 둘 것이다."
ko.B: 이방 사람들이 그의 이름에 소망을 둘 것이다."
ko.R: 모든 민족이 그에게 소망을 둘 것이다."

decisions.choice: the Gentiles will hope in his name: Isaiah 42:4 in the Greek Old Testament
decisions.reason: Here Matthew follows the Greek Old Testament. The Hebrew says the coastlands will wait for his teaching.

decisions.choice: his name: the servant himself, all that he is
decisions.reason: To hope in someone's name is to hope in that person.

decisions.choice: in him
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means.

decisions.choice: "그에게" (R) for "in his name"
decisions.reason: His name is the servant himself, all that he is (meaning decision); Readable says so, as the English Readable does. The quotation closes here.
